_howto: This file is the club roster shown on imadalisyed.com/club.
After you verify someone's EMPLID and student email, add an entry below and push.
Fields: name (required), role (required), joined (optional ISO date or date-time), founding (optional true).
Roles the page styles: President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer,
CTF Team Lead, Workshop Lead, Events Lead, Member.
Any other role string still renders, it just uses the default badge.
Leave 'joined' out for founding officers and the page prints 'founding officer' instead of a date.
Newest joiners sort to the top automatically. Never put EMPLIDs or emails in this file.
